outcome: respiratory hospitalisation after the age of 3 years
cohort: 145,580 children in Western Australia born between 1997 and 2002
finding: Recurrent hospitalisations for acute respiratory infection in infancy significantly increase the risk of respiratory morbidity and asthma requiring hospitalisation after the age of 3 years.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was a stratifying factor but there were no specific findings relating to mode of delivery.
